cross_scale_comparison_semantics.absolute_jct_and_first_output: matched workload scale required for ranking
cross_scale_comparison_semantics.first_output_fraction_of_e2e: streaming/materialization diagnostic only; not normalized latency
cross_scale_comparison_semantics.rate_and_unit_resource_metrics: descriptive comparison allowed after each arm independently reaches a steady throughput plateau

cpu_core_seconds_estimate.comparison_scope: same host and sampling contract; normalize per image across scale
cpu_core_seconds_estimate.formula: host mean equivalent busy cores * operator_e2e_s
cpu_core_seconds_estimate.limitations: includes unrelated host work and is not actor-attributed
cpu_core_seconds_estimate.meaning_zh: 整个主机在算子窗口内估算消耗的 CPU 核秒

estimated_e2e_mfu.comparison_scope: only when both supplied constants are independently verified
estimated_e2e_mfu.limitations: blank by default; not measured FLOPs and includes non-model E2E stages
estimated_e2e_mfu.meaning_zh: 按给定模型每图 FLOPs 和对应 dtype GPU 峰值估算的端到端模型 FLOPs 利用率
estimated_e2e_mfu.source: explicit CLI model FLOPs and dtype-matched hardware peak

first_output_fraction_of_e2e.limitations: dimensionless does not mean workload-independent; not normalized latency
first_output_fraction_of_e2e.meaning_zh: 首批结果出现时已经消耗的算子总时间比例，越接近 1 越像先物化后返回

first_output_s.comparison_scope: absolute ranking requires matched workload scale
first_output_s.formula: first completed output timestamp - operator start
first_output_s.limitations: first batch size may differ; it is not LLM TTFT or per-image latency
first_output_s.meaning_zh: 从同一冷启动边界到第一个完整 Arrow record batch 返回的时间
first_output_s.source: stream iterator or first completed project Ray batch

gpu_active_util_mean_pct.formula: mean utilization over samples from active devices
gpu_active_util_mean_pct.limitations: not MFU; short kernels and sub-sample idle gaps may be missed
gpu_active_util_mean_pct.meaning_zh: 按显存占用识别出的活跃 GPU 在采样点上的平均 nvidia-smi utilization

gpu_energy_estimate_j.comparison_scope: same sampler interval and timing boundary
gpu_energy_estimate_j.formula: mean summed active-device power watts * sampler wall seconds
gpu_energy_estimate_j.limitations: not hardware energy counter integration; misses pre/post-window energy
gpu_energy_estimate_j.meaning_zh: 活跃 GPU 在算子采样窗口内的估算能耗

gpu_seconds_per_image.limitations: allocation time, not active kernel time
gpu_seconds_per_image.meaning_zh: 每张图片分摊的已分配 GPU 墙钟秒数
gpu_seconds_per_image.source: declared GPU workers and operator wall

host_io_bytes_per_image.comparison_scope: same isolated host; diagnostic cross-scale comparison
host_io_bytes_per_image.limitations: host-wide counters include unrelated traffic and are not process-attributed
host_io_bytes_per_image.meaning_zh: 算子窗口内主机磁盘或网络计数器增量除以处理图片数

images_per_cpu_core_second.comparison_scope: per-image resource comparison on the same host
images_per_cpu_core_second.meaning_zh: 每消耗一个 CPU 核秒完成的图片数
images_per_cpu_core_second.source: row count and host CPU estimate

images_per_s.comparison_scope: cross-scale only after each arm independently reaches a plateau
images_per_s.limitations: short runs can be dominated by setup and are not steady-state capacity
images_per_s.meaning_zh: 处理图片行数吞吐，logical pass 会计入处理行数但不增加 unique images
images_per_s.source: workload row contract and operator monotonic clock

joules_per_1k_images.limitations: inherits power-sampling error and excludes CPU/platform energy
joules_per_1k_images.meaning_zh: 每处理一千张图片的估算 GPU 能耗
joules_per_1k_images.source: GPU energy estimate and row count

logical_h2d_effective_gbps.comparison_scope: project diagnostic runs with identical tensor contract
logical_h2d_effective_gbps.limitations: not a PCIe hardware-counter measurement; unavailable for hidden native engines
logical_h2d_effective_gbps.meaning_zh: 主机到 GPU 的逻辑 tensor 字节除以显式 H2D 阶段墙钟
logical_h2d_effective_gbps.source: project telemetry with CUDA-synchronized detailed stage timing

operator_e2e_s.comparison_scope: absolute ranking requires the same workload size and boundary
operator_e2e_s.limitations: excludes Ray cluster startup and pgvector writeback
operator_e2e_s.meaning_zh: 算子执行从冷模型 worker 边界到最后一批 embedding 返回的墙钟时间

post_first_output_s.limitations: does not reveal how many images were already materialized internally
post_first_output_s.meaning_zh: 首批结果返回后到整个算子结束的剩余墙钟时间

steady_state_duration_gate_met.limitations: passing 60 seconds does not prove a throughput plateau
steady_state_duration_gate_met.meaning_zh: 单次算子运行是否达到预注册的 60 秒最低稳态代理时长
